request: Rename Todo.done to Todo.completed everywhere, and make list hide completed todos by default (includeDone: true shows them).

requests.title: commands > lists, optionally hiding done items
requests.reason: The test asserted list(todos) returns "[x] milk\n[ ] eggs", meaning completed todos show by default. The instruction changes that so completed todos are hidden unless includeDone === true. I updated it to expect "[ ] eggs" by default and "[x] milk\n[ ] eggs" with { includeDone: true }.
